ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels localized at the perimeter and central midline.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white blobs occupy the interior of each lobe. A vertical black band at the peduncle junction bisects the lobes. Dense black pixel clusters are mapped to the trailing edge and tips, particularly concentrated on the far right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 65-degree vertex angle and clearly defined depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency micro-serrations. Right lobe trailing edge features high-amplitude, deep vertical excavations/valleys, appearing as a series of 8 to 10 parallel notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge, sweeping upwards and outwards towards pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of two isolated circular high-contrast spots: one on the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe and one on the interior-mid quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, long diagonal linear disruption on the lower right lobe; multiple smaller horizontal and vertical scratch patterns across both lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe parallel vertical indentations on the outer third of the right lobe trailing edge, indicating significant past physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The outer right trailing edge possesses a unique 'comb-like' geometric structure due to deep, regular vertical tissue loss.
